correctness.rationale: For R=Z/(p^a q), p≠q, the nonzero proper divisor ideals are exactly A_i=(p^i), i=1..a, and B_j=(p^j q), j=0..a−1. Products give no A–A edges, A_i B_j adjacency iff i+j≥a, B_j B_k adjacency iff j+k≥a. Every independent set with a selected B has a unique largest B-index m; it may use any of a−m−1 A-vertices and min(m,a−m) lower B-vertices, which are mutually compatible. Therefore I(G;x)=(1+x)^a+Σ_{m=0}^{a−1}x(1+x)^[a−m−1+min(m,a−m)], equal to the claimed closed expression. Maximality forces all these vertices, giving exactly a+1 facets, alpha=a, floor(a/2)+2 maximum sets, well-covered iff a≤2, and independent domination 1 at a=1 and 2 otherwise. Independent exhaustive graph enumeration for every a=1..7 reproduced exact polynomials and all facets; arbitrary a follows uniquely from the max-index decomposition.

originality.rationale: Earlier sources establish annihilating-ideal graph definition, weak perfectness and clique/edge-coloring numbers for Z_n, or classify rings with small independence number. Such results do not give the complete independence-polynomial enumerator or list all maximal independent sets for this one-parameter infinite arithmetic family. The Resultary comparable findings concern different domination invariants or distinct graph constructions; a possible graph-theoretic renaming of the exact threshold graph remains a priority risk.
residual_risks: The exact 2a-vertex family may have been studied under a graph-theoretic alias or be a known split/threshold graph with an implicit facet polynomial.
The result is for p^a q only, not p^a q^b with both exponents larger than one.
Computations a≤7 cannot replace all-a combinatorial proof.

value.rationale: The independence polynomial and complete maximal-facet list are canonical graph invariants, strictly stronger than independence number or clique number. The infinite semiprime-power family receives a closed formula for every independent-set size, the exact maximum-set multiplicities and the natural well-covered boundary at a=2, with downstream independent domination readily determined. The result is not an arbitrary finite slice.
